Summer Update 2026

Released on July 13, 2026.

General Properties

Update Version

15.30.a30dad

Type

Major
Summer

Previous Update

15.25.bd5a04
(Major: 15.20.7a5cc9)

Next Update

15.30.004fb1
(Major: Next Update)

Summary

Introduction of the Make Believe Quest, containing the toughest boss fights released yet, as well as the new Moonsilver Set best-in-slot equipment. Introduction of the Shards of a Broken Moon Quest. Implementation of Echo Raids, new achievements, highscores, mounts, improvements of the Discovery System and Weapon Proficiency system, etc.

See also: Updates Help

Update Video

Update Teasers

  1. Shards of a Broken Moon
  2. Echo Raids and Discovery System
  3. Rise to the Heavens
  4. Make Believe
  5. Weapon Proficiency Update
  6. Summer Update Changes during Test Server

Test Server

  • On June 23, 2026, the Summer Update 2026 Test Server began.
  • On July 07, 2026, the Summer Update 2026 Test Server closed.

Changes

  • Implementation of Shards of a Broken Moon Quest, a new premium account quest that leads players deeper into the realm of the Asuri.
    • New mounts, new items, and new achievements as rewards.
    • New Asura Citadel hunting place, with difficulty is comparable to Asura Vaults.
  • Echo Raids
    • Creatures can occasionally turn into stationary echoes, that trigger a small raid with creatures of the same kind.
    • Triggering an Echo Raid usually spawns regular creatures or a smaller group of influenced creatures, rarely an Echo Warden.
      • Echo Wardens are stronger versions of the creature that empower nearby creatures, making the fight more dangerous.
      • Defeating an Echo Warden for the first time for a specific creature type will grant additional Charm Points. The progress will be visible in the Bestiary.
    • New achievements are available tied to Echo Raids.
  • Discovery System
    • All subareas are now active automatically. It is not needed anymore to manually start discoveries per area in the Cyclopedia.
    • You can still reset points of interest via the Cyclopedia; related messages/quest texts will be adjusted.
    • Fully discovering areas now grants extra movement speed within those areas, with the bonus scaling from 100 to 195 speed.
  • Introduction of Make Believe Quest as a new, dynamic, high risk/high reward experience, where a dubious prophet preaches a gospel that godhood is not only within his reach, but also his birthright.
    • Extra challenging bosses (Tibia's most challenging boss experience yet) and gameplay mechanics for high level players, especially calling on those who already conquered Rotten Blood Quest, Soul War Quest, and Primal Ordeal Quest.
      • Introduction of the Boss Difficulty System:
        • Higher difficulties must first be unlocked by defeating bosses. Every character unlocks progress individually, encouraging groups to steadily work their way upwards.
        • Greater risks come with greater rewards. Higher difficulties increase loot chances and are required for exclusive rewards. To reward persistence, your chance of obtaining new Moonsilver equipment increases until you receive one.
      • Competitive players can climb the new Phosphorus Record, a highscores ranking based on the highest boss difficulty completed or try to get the new achievements.
    • New best-in-slot weapons and helmets for all vocations.
      • Moonsilver weapons and helmets become the new best-in-slot equipment. Through Weapon Proficiency, the weapons can be tailored to suit your preferred playstyle and individual needs.
      • Even stronger Stellar Moonsilver variants can be crafted.
    • Players who face the new bosses will get to choose how merciless the fight should be, having the possibility to scale the difficulty of fights in an accessible way, allowing fine-tuning in its severity.
      • Every group can choose how challenging a fight should be, from a safe learning mode to the highest difficulties, with new mechanics, stronger bosses and greater rewards.
      • Some rewards are only available to higher difficulties.
      • New achievements will be available regarding the boss fights.
      • A new highscore, the Phosphorus Record, will be introduced to list every player who has slain the end boss, ranked by the highest difficulty of a single victorious fight.
    • A new mount and a new outfit also introduced as reward.
  • Weapon Proficiency Update
    • A new system allows players to manipulate up to two perk slots of each weapon's proficiency tree, replacing effects for others that might be more suitable for their needs.
    • Modifying the first slot costs 250 Dust and requires at least Proficiency Level 3; a second slot costs 1,000 Dust and requires that players have mastered the weapon.
    • When a slot is modified, a random effect is rolled at its lowest value. Modified slots can:
      • be refined to raise their value step by step at a rising Dust cost
      • maximised straight to the highest value using a new tradeable loot item
      • reshaped to roll three fresh effects to swap in or skip
      • cleared to restore the original perk for free
    • The pool of possible effects is large and varied. Some effects augment specific spells per vocation, making it hit harder or return more mana and HP.
    • The core resource is dust, which is bound to the character and cannot be transferred, while modified perks and their values stay intact when a character is traded.
    • The maximum amount of dust a character can carry has been raised considerably: every dust limit stage unlocked in the Exaltation Forge now grants far more capacity, while the unlock costs stay the same.
